name: Threnos
tagline: The operating system for the memorial economy.
positioning: Threnos unifies intake, logistics, and remembrance into one platform so funeral networks can honor every life at enterprise scale.

hero.sub: Threnos is the connective infrastructure beneath modern funeral networks — orchestrating intake, transport, care, and remembrance across every location from a single command layer.

features.title: Unified case intake
features.description: Replace the fax-and-clipboard first call. Every arrangement enters one record — family details, faith requirements, deadlines — routed to the right chapel instantly.

features.title: Fleet & transfer logistics
features.description: Coordinate removals, embalming windows, and cross-facility transfers on a live map. No more phone-tree dispatch between locations at 3am.

features.title: Compliance ledger
features.description: Every disposition permit, cremation authorization, and chain-of-custody signature captured, timestamped, and audit-ready across all 50 states.

features.title: Remembrance studio
features.description: Generate memorial pages, order-of-service sheets, and tribute streams in minutes — templated to each brand in your network.

features.title: Capacity forecasting
features.description: Model volume, staffing, and cold-storage against seasonal mortality trends so no facility is caught short during surge weeks.

features.title: Network analytics
features.description: Roll up service margins, caseload, and family satisfaction across every location into one executive dashboard.

testimonials.quote: Before Threnos we ran forty-one homes on twelve different systems. Now a director in Ohio and a director in Arizona see the same case in real time. It changed how we think about scale.
testimonials.name: Marguerite Delacroix

testimonials.quote: The compliance ledger alone paid for the rollout. During our last state audit, we exported every authorization in an afternoon instead of six weeks of pulling paper files.
testimonials.name: Harold Ashby

testimonials.quote: Threnos treats remembrance as infrastructure, not an afterthought. Families feel the difference, and our directors finally have time to be present with them.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman

pricing.blurb: For single and small multi-location homes stepping into one system.
For regional networks coordinating logistics across many facilities.
For national operators and consolidators with bespoke requirements.

homepage.footerBlurb: Threnos is the operating system for the memorial economy — infrastructure for those entrusted with the end of every story.
